python -c "import json,glob;fs=sorted(glob.glob('bench/data/*.json'));ks=[set(json.load(open(f,encoding='utf-8')).keys()) for f in fs];print(fs);print([sorted(k) for k in ks]);import functools;inter=functools.reduce(lambda a,b:a&b,ks);print('INTERSECTION=',sorted(inter));print('UNION=',sorted(functools.reduce(lambda a,b:a|b,ks)))"
